title: Data for Canada - Environment, Climate, and Health Data Packages
description: Time-series measurements from a network of low-cost IoT environmental monitoring stations across Canada. Each station records particulate matter (PM1, PM2.5, PM10), particle size distributions, gas concentrations (oxidised, reducing, NH3), temperature, pressure, humidity, and light intensity. Companion health assets capture per-station device telemetry (CPU load, memory, WiFi signal, battery) to support quality-control filtering.
